## S01 / F01 fuel storage (FUEL-SPLIT, WORKING, S&E 15_MODEL_INTERFACES A229:J229)

- Function: hold the 27-lobe He-3 store in the aft body and the H2/D2 cryogenic store in a forward torus, and feed the four
  feed run tanks (renamed from `Tank_Volume_0n`: they are the drive's short-term run tanks, not the voyage inventory).
- Fixed: inventories (He-3 164.8 t, D2 110.1 t, H2 145.1 + 180 t), the body radius 6.5 m, ring sweeps (r 30, X 82.9..93.2),
  bypass collar (r 33–35, aft 82.02), the keel lanes 30/150/270.
- Decisions (PROTOTYPE): 9 body modules × 3 lobes (100° span, r 1.1–4.72); torus R 20.5, a 4.5 at X 100.6 split into vessels
  by three gaps (50/195/315) that keep the EVA azimuth and the keel lanes clear; D2 in vessel 3's 32° end cell. Torus lines
  leave on the outer equator, ride the bypass collar at r 32.5 (clear of both ring sweeps), drop at X 82.02 and enter the
  hull at X 80.02 (penetration OPEN), then run along the 3.6 m lanes over the pulse bank and battery to the run tanks.
  Cryocoolers on each module (r 3.9–4.6), lobe hangers to the frames, struts from the torus to the collar skin.
- Fit screen margins: He-3 +1690 m³, D2 +65 m³, H2 +416 m³ at 3 % ullage.
- Open: hull penetration detail, boil-off and cryocooler power (not budgeted), torus support loads, MLI thickness.
